svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 10/12 June Gloom (Common)
svg.desc: The marine layer rolls in grey and soft and stays till noon. Bring a sweatshirt to the beach. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
